name: ODS
description: Turn your PC, Mac, or Linux box into an AI server. LLM inference, chat UI, voice, agents, workflows, RAG, and image generation.
one_liner: An installer that turns any spare computer into your own private AI server with chat, voice, image generation, and automation, no manual setup required.
buyer: A small law firm, accounting practice, or freelancer who wants private, in-house AI tools without sending client data to the cloud.
business_use_cases: An IT reseller sells pre-configured 'AI-in-a-box' mini PCs to local law or accounting firms that need private, on-prem AI for confidentiality.
A homelab hardware shop bundles ODS with a mini PC as a plug-and-play private AI server for prosumers.
A managed service provider offers 'private AI server setup and maintenance' as a recurring service to SMB clients.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a pre-configured hardware bundle with ODS already installed and tuned.
Charge a monthly retainer for setup, updates, and support of a client's private AI box.

steal_this: Buy a mini PC, install ODS on it, and sell it this weekend to one local small business worried about sending client data to ChatGPT.
